paragraphs.text: Agent skills for the Lark/Feishu CLI (lark-cli), packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle. Exclu
des lark-im to complement an IM bridge plugin.
> A **DeepSeek Harness plugin** that brings the Lark/Feishu CLI agent skills into your DSH agent's c
eepSeek Harness plugin** that brings the Lark/Feishu CLI agent skills into your DSH agent's catalog.
Agent skills for the Lark/Feishu CLI, packaged as a **DeepSeek Harness** plugin bundle.
Once installed, the DSH agent can consult and use 27 Lark/Feishu skills — docs, Base, calendar, driv
e, tasks, wiki, approval, mail, slides, meetings, and more.
This package **deliberately omits** the `lark-im` (instant messaging) skill.
IM channels are normally handled by a dedicated bridge plugin (for example `@xmanrui/dsh-im`). Shipp
ing both would overlap and risk conflicting instructions, so this package covers only **non-IM** Lar
k capabilities — it **complements** an IM bridge instead of duplicating it.
If you do want `lark-im`, read it directly with `lark-cli skills read lark-im`, or remove it from th
**`lark-cli` must be installed** — every skill documents its commands:
The skills are plain Markdown, but without the CLI their commands cannot run.
Restart DSH afterwards; the skills appear in the agent's catalog.
Skill text is **exported** from the locally installed `lark-cli` binary, never hand-written:

- **Skill text**: from `@larksuite/cli`, **MIT License**, copyright Lark/Feishu. See NOTICE.
- **Plu
gin glue code** (`lib/`, `scripts/`, config): MIT License, copyright the authors of this repository.
This package does **not** modify upstream skill text (beyond writing it to files) and does **not** c
Exported skills are **generic documentation** and contain no account data.
The sync script reads only the public output of `lark-cli skills list/read`; it never touches `~/.la
rk-cli/config.json`, credential storage, or any personal data.
